ranked_methods.reason: This method in lifetime_collector neglects to push a binder for bare trait objects (TyKind::Path resolving to a trait). Since rustc_resolve::late binds the elided lifetime in Fn(&()) to the bare trait object's ty.id, the collector must push t.id to current_binders when encountering such a path, otherwise it incorrectly assumes the lifetime is free and captures it in the impl Trait.

This is where the bug manifests during collection: if the binder (ty.id for the bare trait object) was not pushed to self.current_binders by visit_ty, this method incorrectly adds the fresh lifetime to self.collected_lifetimes, passing it to lower_opaque_inner.

This method correctly handles explicit PolyTraitRefs by pushing the trait_ref.ref_id binder. The fix in visit_ty will need to mimic this logic for bare trait objects, making it an important reference for the correct invariant.
